title: Bellow and Zach Train
blurb: Zach teaches Bellow swordfighting with sticks on a forest planet, and the lessons slowly turn into quiet talks about home, old crews and what happened on Barbona.

---

*The Hori- sorry, Goblinators are parked in some random forest planet, presumably for supplies that they keep running out of. And while everyone is out shopping, Zach hangs back and walks the forest, picking up and examining various sticks on the ground.*

Bellow had finished shopping when he received a text from Zach.

“[*Meet me outside the ship in two hours.*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow looks at the text confused, but he’ll entertain it.

Two hours pass and Bellow exits the ship, he turns the corner to see Zach holding two sticks, each a different length.

“[Uh… Zach? What are you doing?]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*You said you had interest in swordfighting, correct?*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow chuckles.

“[Well yes… but I didn’t think we’d be doing this now. I mean… I don’t have a sword myself yet...]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*So? Better now instead of later, besides, we can go over basics right now, then when you get a sword, we can talk about personal styles.*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow nods. Zach tosses Bellow the longer stick. “[*Let’s start with your stance. So show me what you think the proper stance is.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[O-Ok…]{Bellow Brightlight}” Bellow then holds the stick with all four hands. He raises it and it looks correct, but he is tense all throughout his body. Zach shook his head and walked over. He pointed his stick at Bellow’s shoulders.

“[*Relax your shoulders-*]{Zacharias Smith}” He then pointed at Bellow’s knees.

“[*Bend your knees.*]{Zacharias Smith}” He then walks in front of Bellow before getting into his stance with his stick. “[*The trick is to remain loose so that you can make movements quickly, if you stay stiff, you have to take time to relax your body. It’s better to stay relaxed. Next lesson.*]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach rushes towards Bellow and swings, Bellow panics a little and goes to block, which he does in succession.

“[*Oh good, you know how to block.*]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach resets his position. “[*The only thing is to not panic, keep a level head even when you’re at a disadvantage. And always keep your eyes on the opponent. Got it?*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow nods. “[*Good, now let’s try this again.*]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach swings again and Bellow doesn’t panic this time, he blocks. Zach swings again and Bellow blocks, but he staggers back. Zach resets.

“[*You have to move, staying still will get you hit. Moving backwards is sometimes the move.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Zach… this is very confusing…]{Bellow Brightlight}” Bellow admits, dropping his stance in defeat. Zach drops his stance as well.

“[*I’m sorry, I’m going too fast, aren’t I?*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[A little…]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*Then let’s slow down, let’s just go back and forth for right now, and don’t put all your strength into it, remember… these are sticks.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[*Chuckle* Right.]{Bellow Brightlight}”

***

The next time Bellow gets a text from Zach, Zach says to meet him when it’s dark. An odd request, but he pays no mind to it.

It’s dark when Bellow turns the corner and sees Zach sat crisscrossed near a campfire.

“[What’s this? I thought we were training…]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*We are training. Part of being a swordsman is keeping a clear head in battle at all times. So this lesson we’ll be meditating. And also just… talking.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Talking?]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*Sometimes it’s better to just talk about stuff that plagues our thoughts instead of trying to meditate it out.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[I guess…]{Bellow Brightlight}” Bellow joins Zach and copies him, crossing his legs as he sat down.

“[*Now… take a deep breath, and as you exhale, take in the sounds around you.*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow closes his eyes and breathes in.

…

*The chirping of crickets*

*The crackling of the campfire*

*Maybe a few frogs*

*The gentle breeze rustling the leaves of the trees*

***

“[*Now then, do these sounds remind you of anything?*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[It reminds me of… home.]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*Oh…*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow opens his eyes.

“[Did… did I say something wrong?]{Bellow Brightlight}” Zach realizes he typed that out and started panicking.

“[*N-No! It’s just that… well… you never talk about your home that often…*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Because I don’t need to? I mean… no one on the crew talked about their home… so…]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*That’s true, but it’s nice that through meditation, you’re reminded of something familiar.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[I guess… wait, what are you reminded of when you meditate?]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*The old ship I was on…*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow is looking at Zach fully now.

“[That’s right! You had a crew before this… sorry for your loss… I guess…]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*It was nothing, never had any real connections to any of them besides the Captain… even then all he did for me was let me on the crew and taught me how to use a sword properly.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Well… I say thanks to him then. After all, I get to receive training now.]{Bellow Brightlight}” Zach smiles a little.

“[*Right, anyway, break over. Let’s continue.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

***

They continue this for several days, Bellow is getting faster and even managing to get a few hits in. Zach is proud of Bellow’s progress, but as the days go by Zach keeps remembering what happened on Barbona. It’s distracting him and he takes a nasty swing to the face.

“[Oh my God Zach! Are you ok?]{Bellow Brightlight}” Bellow shouts, dropping his stick and grabbing Zach’s arm and directing him to sit down, leaning against the ship. “[Let’s sit down, and I should have some stuff on hand. Oh God…I’m so sorry!]{Bellow Brightlight}” Bellow started pulling out various medical supplies, starting with disinfectant wipes and rubbing at the cut.

“[*It’s… fine…*]{Zacharias Smith}” Zach is out of it.

“[It’s bleeding Zach! This isn’t fine…]{Bellow Brightlight}” Bellow finishes cleaning the cut and examines it. “[Oh good, it doesn’t need stitches.]{Bellow Brightlight}” He then started taping bandages. “[You’ve been out of it recently… are you ok?]{Bellow Brightlight}” Zach thinks about it for a second.

“[*I never apologized for what happened on Barbona…*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow paused then continued.

“[Oh… that… don’t worry about it…]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*But I tried to kill you guys!*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[And? With what we went through before you showed up… and heck, what we go through now, we- or at least I’m- used to being in near-death situations…]{Bellow Brightlight}” Zach is confused.

“[*So… you’re not mad?*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[It’s water under the bridge… besides… you haven’t tried killing us since. So…]{Bellow Brightlight}” Bellow has a point… he finishes taping the bandages.

“[*Thanks…*]{Zacharias Smith}” Bellow smiles.

“[No problem, now shall we continue training, or are we done for today?]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*When do we leave this planet?*]{Zacharias Smith}”

“[Whenever Seth can actually secure resources… so maybe another day or so…]{Bellow Brightlight}”

“[*Let’s stop for today.*]{Zacharias Smith}”

***

Zach can feel that his bond with Bellow has grown, maybe one day…

Bellow can see the stars…
